class Component extends DCLogic {
  state = { r: null };

  async componentDidMount() {
    const router = await __ulmImport('assets/js/router.js');
    this.setState({ r: router });
  }

  renderVals() {
    const R = this.state.r;
    const url = R ? R.url : (x => x);
    const ROUTES = R ? R.ROUTES : {};

    return {
      landingHref: url('landing'),
      credentials: [
        { role: 'Administrator', email: 'admin@uloominate.com', password: 'admin1234', note: 'Both approval queues, payouts, plans and the launch switch.' },
        { role: 'Vendor — Premium, approved', email: 'reyes@literacylane.com', password: 'vendor1234', note: 'Full dashboard with real sales, earnings and payout history.' },
        { role: 'Vendor — Pioneer, free tier', email: 'yusra@kindergartenhub.org', password: 'vendor1234', note: 'Blocked from paid listings, to test the cap message.' },
        { role: 'Vendor — pending approval', email: 'contact@muslimlegacyseries.com', password: 'vendor1234', note: 'Held state; publishing unavailable until approved.' },
        { role: 'Customer', email: 'aisha.rahman@example.com', password: 'customer1234', note: 'Existing purchases, downloads and a wishlist.' },
      ],
      groups: PAGES.map(([id, title, blurb, accent, pages]) => ({
        id: 'grp-' + id, title, blurb, accent,
        count: pages.length + ' pages',
        pages: pages.map(([pid, route, ptitle, purpose]) => {
          const built = BUILT.includes(route);
          return {
            id: pid, title: ptitle, purpose, accent,
            href: ROUTES[route] || '#',
            file: ROUTES[route] || '',
            badge: built ? 'BUILT' : 'PLANNED',
            badgeBg: built ? '#EAF7F1' : '#F3F4F6',
            badgeInk: built ? '#3A836B' : '#8A928E',
          };
        }),
      })),
    };
  }
}
